contract.status: fixed before V5 fits; exploratory after several development rounds and the original final result were viewed
contract.objective: Test model/training improvement on exactly the original six inputs, forecast close, raw next-close return and development calendar; no new information, announcement offset, target change or shortened lead time
unchanged: original three development folds and seeds 11/23/37
LSTM hidden size 32, tanh projection dimension 3
two Gaussian rules and two affine experts
contract.model: u=training-normalized tanh(W h+b), q=[u,1], alpha=normalized diagonal Gaussian memberships, expert1=q@(b+d), expert2=q@(b-d), prediction=q@b+(alpha1-alpha2)*(q@d)
contract.algebra: For independent experts beta1=b+d, beta2=b-d, lambda*(||beta1||^2+||beta2||^2)=2*lambda*(||b||^2+||d||^2). Reparameterization with the mapped penalty is exactly equivalent and is tested, not counted as an empirical improvement.
attribution: common_matched changes only common penalty from 0.2 to 0.1
primary changes only local penalty from 0.2 to 1.0 relative to common_matched
linear removes local branch but has the same common penalty
gate control has the same shared/local objective; Gaussian-specific superiority is secondary, not required to call a whole-model training gain
common_training_extensions_vs_V1: reuse H12 train-only latent affine normalization and deterministic two-cluster Gaussian initialization
positive widths softplus+0.05, not V1 bounded widths
differentiable ridge solve for all affine coefficients including intercepts
raw y divided by training standard deviation without centering; zero standardized prediction means zero raw return
full-batch AdamW; select epoch zero or trained representation within inner set; zero prediction is an explicit fallback, never called a learned improvement
contract.selection: Track best fitted model from epoch 0 by inner raw-target scaled MSE; early stop after 20 unimproved epochs. Use it only if its inner loss improves zero prediction by at least 1e-4; otherwise output zero. Reinitialize with identical seed and refit full outer train for the selected fitted epoch. Save fitted predictions even when fallback is used, for labeled diagnosis only; do not promote them based on outer results.
contract.budget: five configurations x three folds x three seeds =45 inner/outer runs; no hyperparameter, width, seed or penalty search after results; stop this package if primary fails
necessary_references: original V1 Fuzzy2, LSTM3, LSTM32 and Gate2
original six-input Ridge and train mean
matched new linear and ordinary gate
contract.metrics: seed-mean pooled RMSE/MAE on 378 common development dates; every seed and fold; no seed ensemble
contract.model_material_goal: >=3% lower RMSE than Z0 and original V1 Fuzzy2 and LSTM3, >=2/3 fold wins against each, >=6/9 paired wins against original learned references, MAE <=1% worse against each. This is a project decision criterion, not an instructor requirement or a significance claim.
contract.candidate_floor: same comparisons and stability with >=1% RMSE gain; winning only against a weak learned reference or reverting to Z0 is insufficient
contract.head_contribution: report primary vs same-training linear, gate, independent and common-matched separately. No claim of local or Gaussian contribution when only common training improves. >=1% gain, >=2 folds and >=6/9 paired wins is a descriptive head-increment candidate threshold.
contract.mechanism: save common/local predictions, expert difference, weights, raw-membership coverage, train-defined local regions and per-region expert errors; compare removing only the fitted local term as a diagnostic, not another selectable model; report fallback and fitted-only losses separately
contract.uncertainty: paired loss circular block bootstrap within folds, lengths5/10/20,5000 resamples,seed20261105; average seed loss by date, do not count seeds as independent dates; descriptive only, no correction for earlier multi-round exploration
contract.boundary: original final period excluded from training, stopping, new predictions and ranking; old frozen files unchanged; no trading policy optimization; no new external data
contract.authorization: Ryan explicitly requested one round of this model-only direction; course approval is reported for the core architecture, not asserted for these new training details
